raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Speculative decoding can accept a block that extends past EOS or `max_new_tokens`. The decode result processor updated reasoning usage before applying that boundary, so a four-token completion could report six reasoning tokens and consume a reasoning terminator that was never emitted. This was also observed in GLM-5.3 MTP responses ending at the output limit.

Update reasoning accounting after finish-state calculation, using only the retained prefix of the current block. The generated tokens, sampling, stop decision, and native draft-acceptance counters are unchanged.

Validation:
- The new actual-module CPU regression fails on unchanged upstream main for both EOS and length boundaries (`6 != 4`), and passes with this change. It exercises real speculative result normalization, request finish handling, and the reasoning matcher; cache release, metrics and output transport are stubbed.
- 37 tests plus four subtests pass across speculative grammar/reasoning, hidden-state output, length, string-stop and grammar-stop suites. The tests also preserve an end marker spanning two decode steps and exclude answer tokens from reasoning usage.
- On GLM-5.3 FP8/BF16-KV, ROCm 7.2.4, MI355X P4+D4 with three-step native MTP, the unpatched model control reproduces `reasoning_tokens=4` with `completion_tokens=2`. The patched candidate passes all 16 chat responses, including 2/3/4/7-token reasoning boundaries repeated twice. All boundaries report reasoning usage equal to completion usage; native counters, protocol, PDD handoff and cancellation pass. Raw streams and request hashes are replayed by the [bench audit producer](https://github.com/MarloweAI/marlowe-bench/pull/116).
- The pinned downstream image also passes all 37 actual-module tests. Its metadata tuple differs from current upstream, so a test-only 17-field fixture adaptation was mounted read-only; the production fix is unchanged and hash-verified. This is accounting validation, not a sampling-equivalence claim.
- Ruff lint/format and `git diff --check` pass. Hosted CI currently stops at the draft-PR gate; the model-serving and unit results above are separately executed validation.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_batch_result_processor_spec_grammar.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_batch_result_processor_hidden_states.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_finish_length_speculative.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_stop_str_speculative.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_grammar_stop_speculative.py
```

Independent change based on upstream main `a0ba1968b161f1d2989aaacfdbd88a7e522d59a1`; it does not depend on the separate PDD requested-score transport fix in #41455.

 import unittest
 from types import SimpleNamespace

 import torch
 
@@ -71,17 +72,17 @@ def _make_processor() -> SchedulerBatchResultProcessor:
         enable_overlap=False,
         enable_overlap_mlx=False,
         model_config=SimpleNamespace(think_end_ids=None),

@@ -178,6 +179,66 @@ def test_resolve_keeps_all_when_grammar_not_terminated(self):
 
 
 class TestReasoningTokenAccounting(CustomTestCase):
+    def _decode(self, processor, req, tokens):
+        # Exercise the real speculative result normalization, finish handling,
+        # and reasoning matcher; only cache release/metrics/transport are stubbed.
+        batch = _FakeBatch([req])
+        batch.return_logprob = False
+        batch.batch_size = lambda: 1
+        result = _make_result(len(tokens), [len(tokens)], tokens)
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                SchedulerBatchResultProcessor, "_handle_finish_state_updated_req"
+            ),
+            patch(
+                "sglang.srt.managers.scheduler_components."
+                "batch_result_processor.get_observability",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(enable_metrics=False),
+            ),
+        ):
+            processor.process_batch_result_decode(batch, result)
+
+    def test_speculative_suffix_past_finish_is_not_reasoning(self):
+        """An accepted suffix beyond the output cap/EOS must not affect usage.
+
+        The old decode path counted the full verify run before applying its
+        stop boundary, reporting more reasoning tokens than completion tokens
+        and consuming a reasoning terminator that was never emitted.
+        """
+        for stop_at_eos in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(stop_at_eos=stop_at_eos):
+                req = _make_req(terminate_after=99)
+                req.grammar = None
+                req.require_reasoning = True
+                req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens = 8 if stop_at_eos else 4
+                req.eos_token_ids = {2} if stop_at_eos else set()
+                processor = _make_processor()
+                processor.model_config.think_end_ids = [7, 8]
+
+                self._decode(processor, req, [10, 11])
+                self.assertFalse(req.finished())
+                self._decode(processor, req, [12, 2, 7, 8])
+
+                self.assertEqual(list(req.output_ids_through_stop), [10, 11, 12, 2])
+                self.assertEqual(req.reasoning_tokens, 4)
+                self.assertFalse(req._is_reasoning_over)
+                self.assertEqual(req._think_end_match_len, 0)
+
+    def test_reasoning_end_before_finish_keeps_answer_out_of_reasoning(self):
+        req = _make_req(terminate_after=99)
+        req.grammar = None
+        req.require_reasoning = True
+        req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens = 4
+        processor = _make_processor()
+        processor.model_config.think_end_ids = [7, 8]
+
+        self._decode(processor, req, [10, 7])
+        self._decode(processor, req, [8, 11, 12, 13])
+
+        self.assertEqual(list(req.output_ids_through_stop), [10, 7, 8, 11])
+        self.assertEqual(req.reasoning_tokens, 3)
+        self.assertTrue(req._is_reasoning_over)
+
     def test_multi_token_end_can_span_decode_steps(self):
         req = _make_req(terminate_after=99)
         req.require_reasoning = True
